en.title: MulDet3D
en.description: Multi-Objective Optimization Based Unsupervised Object Detection for Multiple Roadside LiDARs
en.body:
Roadside LiDAR systems offer a promising infrastructure-based approach for traffic monitoring, but detecting objects across multiple sensors with varying fields of view remains challenging — especially without labeled training data.

MulDet3D proposes an unsupervised object detection framework that jointly optimizes detection accuracy and computational efficiency across multiple roadside LiDARs. Key contributions include:

  • A multi-objective optimization formulation that balances detection performance across overlapping and non-overlapping sensor zones
  • An unsupervised pipeline that eliminates the need for manually annotated 3D bounding boxes
  • Robust handling of sparse point clouds typical in roadside (infrastructure-side) deployments

This work addresses a critical gap in infrastructure-based sensing for intelligent transportation systems, enabling scalable deployment without costly labeling efforts.

Patent application

Meng, S., Ai, C., & Xie, Y. (2026). System and method for unsupervised object detection using multiple LiDAR sensors. U.S. provisional patent application No. 64/085,047, filed June 8, 2026.

zh.title: MulDet3D
zh.description: 基于多目标优化的多路侧激光雷达无监督目标检测
zh.body:
路侧激光雷达为交通监测提供了基于基础设施的感知方式，但在多个视场不同的传感器之间进行目标检测仍面临挑战，尤其是在缺少标注训练数据时。

MulDet3D 提出无监督目标检测框架，联合优化多个路侧激光雷达的检测精度与计算效率：

  • 通过多目标优化，平衡传感器重叠区域与非重叠区域的检测表现
  • 无需人工标注三维边界框，减少部署中的数据标注成本
  • 针对路侧场景中的稀疏点云进行稳健处理

该研究支持智能交通系统中可扩展的基础设施感知部署。

专利申请

Meng, S., Ai, C., & Xie, Y. (2026). System and method for unsupervised object detection using multiple LiDAR sensors. 美国临时专利申请，申请号 64/085,047，申请日为 2026 年 6 月 8 日。

en.title: FRGB3D
en.description: Fast Reliability-Weighted Gaussian Background Modeling for Roadside LiDAR Traffic Monitoring
en.body:
Background subtraction is a fundamental step in LiDAR-based traffic monitoring. Variations in measurement reliability caused by distance, surface reflectivity, and atmospheric conditions make background–foreground separation challenging.

FRGB3D introduces a fast, reliability-weighted Gaussian background model tailored for roadside LiDAR point clouds. Key contributions include:

  • A physics-based reliability metric that quantifies measurement quality using range and reflectivity
  • Reliability-weighted adaptive learning that adjusts background model learning rates based on point reliability
  • Adaptive foreground detection thresholds that incorporate measurement reliability and learned model uncertainty

Experiments using CARLA and real-world LiDAR data from Lowell, Massachusetts, evaluate performance across weather and traffic conditions. The real-world experiments achieve 19.1 frames per second without requiring labeled training data or GPU infrastructure, supporting practical roadside traffic monitoring.

zh.title: FRGB3D
zh.description: 面向路侧激光雷达交通监测的快速可靠性加权高斯背景建模
zh.body:
背景消除是激光雷达交通监测的基础环节。距离、表面反射率与大气条件导致的测量可靠性差异，增加了背景与前景分离的难度。

FRGB3D 提出适用于路侧激光雷达点云的快速可靠性加权高斯背景模型：

  • 基于测距与反射率特征，构建具有物理依据的测量可靠性指标
  • 依据点的可靠性自适应调整背景模型学习率
  • 结合测量可靠性与模型学习得到的不确定性，自适应设置前景检测阈值

研究采用 CARLA 仿真与美国马萨诸塞州洛厄尔市的实测激光雷达数据，评估不同天气与交通条件下的性能。实测实验处理速度达到 19.1 帧/秒，无需标注训练数据或 GPU 硬件，支持实际路侧交通监测应用。

en.title: MulTrack3D
en.description: Robust multi-point tracking for multiple roadside LiDARs via voting-based consensus
en.body:
Maintaining consistent object identities across frames is a core task in roadside LiDAR perception. Sparse observations and occlusion can interrupt vehicle trajectories and affect downstream traffic analysis.

MulTrack3D studies robust multi-point tracking for multiple roadside LiDARs through voting-based consensus. The framework connects observations over time to support continuous vehicle trajectories.

The work forms the tracking stage of the quality-aware multi-LiDAR research framework, linking object detection with trajectory-based traffic and safety analysis.

zh.title: MulTrack3D
zh.description: 基于投票共识的多路侧激光雷达鲁棒多点跟踪
zh.body:
在连续帧间保持目标身份一致，是路侧激光雷达感知的核心任务。稀疏观测与遮挡可能中断车辆轨迹，进而影响后续交通分析。

MulTrack3D 研究基于投票共识的多路侧激光雷达鲁棒多点跟踪，通过关联不同时刻的观测，支持连续车辆轨迹的构建。

该研究构成质量感知多激光雷达研究框架中的跟踪环节，连接目标检测与基于轨迹的交通及安全分析。

en.title: Roadway Asset Management Optimization
en.description: Multi-objective optimization for integrated roadway asset maintenance and rehabilitation considering traffic dynamics and environmental impacts
en.body:
Roadway asset management involves complex trade-offs between agency costs, user costs, environmental impacts, and network-level performance. Traditional single-objective approaches fail to capture this complexity.

This project develops a multi-objective optimization framework for integrated roadway asset maintenance and rehabilitation (M&R) planning that explicitly accounts for:

  • Traffic dynamics: M&R activities cause lane closures and detours, generating user delay costs that vary by timing and location
  • Environmental impacts: Construction activities and vehicle emissions during work zones are incorporated as optimization objectives
  • Network-level coordination: Segment-level decisions are jointly optimized to maximize network performance

The framework enables transportation agencies to make informed, data-driven investment decisions that balance budget constraints against service quality and sustainability goals.

zh.title: 道路资产管理优化
zh.description: 考虑交通动态与环境影响的道路资产综合养护多目标优化
zh.body:
道路资产管理需要在管理部门成本、用户成本、环境影响和路网表现之间进行权衡，单目标方法难以充分表达这些需求。

本项目构建用于道路资产综合养护规划的多目标优化框架，重点考虑：

  • 交通动态： 养护导致的车道封闭与绕行，以及随时间和位置变化的用户延误成本
  • 环境影响： 将施工活动及施工区域车辆排放纳入优化目标
  • 路网协调： 联合优化路段决策，提升路网整体表现

框架为交通管理部门提供数据驱动的投资决策支持，平衡预算、服务质量与可持续发展目标。

en.title: Pavement Maintenance Planning under Uncertainty
en.description: Network-level pavement maintenance and rehabilitation planning using chance-constrained programming
en.body:
Real-world pavement management is subject to significant uncertainties — in pavement deterioration rates, material costs, traffic growth, and budget availability. Deterministic optimization models cannot adequately address these risks.

This project introduces a chance-constrained programming approach to network-level pavement M&R planning, ensuring that budget and performance constraints are satisfied with a specified probability even under uncertain conditions.

Key contributions include:

  • Formulation of pavement M&R planning as a stochastic optimization problem with probabilistic constraints
  • A tractable solution methodology that converts chance constraints into deterministic equivalents
  • Case studies demonstrating improved reliability of long-term maintenance plans compared to deterministic approaches

zh.title: 不确定性下的路面养护规划
zh.description: 基于机会约束规划的路网级路面养护决策
zh.body:
路面性能衰变、材料成本、交通增长和可用预算均存在不确定性，确定性模型难以充分处理这些风险。

本项目采用机会约束规划方法，使路网级养护方案即使在不确定条件下，也能以给定概率满足预算与性能约束：

  • 将养护规划表述为包含概率约束的随机优化问题
  • 将机会约束转化为可求解的确定性等价形式
  • 通过案例研究，展示相较于确定性方法的长期养护规划可靠性提升

en.title: Airport Curbside Vehicle Detection
en.description: Deep learning-based detection of illegal pick-up vehicles at airport departure levels
en.body:
Illegal pick-up and drop-off activities at airport curbside zones create traffic congestion and safety hazards. Manual enforcement is costly and inconsistent, motivating an automated vision-based detection system.

This project developed an end-to-end deep learning pipeline for detecting and classifying illegal curbside vehicles from surveillance cameras at airport departure levels.

Key contributions include:

  • A video-based vehicle detection and behavior recognition system tailored for airport curbside environments
  • Handling of occlusion, varying lighting, and high vehicle density typical in airport settings
  • Deployment as a functional monitoring system (Software Copyright registered)

Patent and software

  • Deep learning-based automatic detection of illegal vehicles at airport departure levels. Granted Chinese invention patent CN114821490B (2025).
  • Airport curbside illegal vehicle monitoring system. Software copyright (2023); first author: Siyuan Meng.

zh.title: 机场路侧车辆检测
zh.description: 基于深度学习的机场出发层违规接客车辆检测
zh.body:
机场路侧区域的违规接送客行为会带来拥堵与安全隐患，而人工执法成本较高、标准难以保持一致。

本项目构建端到端的深度学习流程，利用机场出发层监控视频检测与识别违规车辆：

  • 面向机场路侧场景开展车辆检测与行为识别
  • 处理遮挡、光照变化和高车辆密度等复杂情况
  • 开发可运行的监测系统，并登记软件著作权

专利与软件成果

  • 一种基于深度学习的机场出发层违章车辆自动识别方法。中国授权发明专利 CN114821490B（2025）。
  • 机场路侧违法车辆监控系统。软件著作权（2023），第一作者：蒙思源。

en.title: Quality-Aware Traffic Conflict Analysis
en.description: Spatial precision, tracking quality, and traffic conflict detectability in roadside LiDAR systems
en.body:
Traffic conflict analysis relies on the positions and trajectories recovered by roadside sensors. This research examines how sensing and tracking quality affect the interactions that can be detected and interpreted.

Two related studies address spatial precision enhancement for multi-LiDAR conflict detection and the relationship between tracking quality and conflict detectability, using ClusterTrack3D as the tracking method under study. Together, they connect roadside perception quality with traffic safety analysis.

zh.title: 质量感知交通冲突分析
zh.description: 路侧激光雷达系统中的空间精度、跟踪质量与交通冲突可检测性
zh.body:
交通冲突分析依赖路侧传感器恢复的目标位置与运动轨迹。本研究关注感知与跟踪质量如何影响交通交互的检测和解释。

两项相关工作分别研究多激光雷达冲突检测中的空间精度增强，以及跟踪质量与冲突可检测性的关系，后者以 ClusterTrack3D 为研究对象，将路侧感知质量与交通安全分析相连接。

en.title: EV Charging and Queue Management
en.description: Station information, request timing, and queue-aware station choice for highway corridors and mixed fleets
en.body:
This research studies how information and charging decisions affect queues in electric transportation systems.

  • Intercity highway corridors: investigate station information and request timing for reducing fast-charging queues.
  • Electric ride-hailing fleets: examine when queue-aware charging-station choice is beneficial in fleets with both autonomous and human-driven vehicles.

These studies form part of a broader research direction on routing and charging coordination under demand and behavioral uncertainty.

zh.title: 电动汽车充电与排队管理
zh.description: 面向高速公路走廊与混合车队的充电站信息、请求时机和排队感知选站
zh.body:
本研究关注信息与充电决策对电动交通系统排队状况的影响。

  • 城际高速公路走廊：研究充电站信息与请求时机对快充排队的影响。
  • 电动网约车车队：研究自动驾驶与人工驾驶车辆共存时，排队感知充电站选择的适用条件。

两项工作共同服务于需求与行为不确定性条件下的路径与充电协同研究。

en.title: Roadside Camera–LiDAR Calibration Reliability
en.description: Calibration drift, point-cloud colorization error, and site-specific recalibration budgets
en.body:
Roadside camera–LiDAR systems combine image and point-cloud information. This research examines the relationship between calibration drift and colorization error, with attention to a saturating error relationship and site-specific recalibration budgets.

The work extends roadside perception research toward the reliability and maintenance of multi-sensor calibration.

zh.title: 路侧相机—激光雷达标定可靠性
zh.description: 标定漂移、点云着色误差与场地特定的重标定预算
zh.body:
路侧相机—激光雷达系统需要联合利用图像与点云信息。本研究关注标定漂移与着色误差的关系，研究误差的饱和规律以及场地特定的重标定预算。

该工作将路侧感知研究拓展至多传感器标定的可靠性与维护。
